label: ISPRS noBoundary / eroded labels

matching.ABS_DSM_MATCHED: Class-balanced matching within the same tile and 0.5 m raw DSM value bins.
matching.LOCAL_GEOM_MATCHED: Class-balanced matching within the same tile and joint quantile cells of local-relative DSM, DSM roughness, and DSM gradient.

important_caveat: Raw DSM is surface elevation, not normalized object height. Therefore raw DSM matching is interpreted only as elevation-value ambiguity. LOCAL_GEOM_MATCHED is the main semantic-disambiguation analysis.

metric_interpretation.balanced_accuracy: 0.5 is approximately chance for binary classification.
metric_interpretation.jsd_bits: 0 indicates identical distributions; larger values mean greater separation.
